messages:
tessa: Quick thread - we need an outbound to ~22 customers about a webhook delivery lag that caused delayed onboarding events and occasional duplicates between 2026-04-02 01:15 UTC and 2026-04-02 04:40 UTC. Draft below + proposed office hours. Comments?

 diego: Yikes. Any data loss? Also, how many are trial vs paid? We should prioritize trials with active signups.

 rachel: No data loss reported, just delivery delays and duplicate event records for a subset of connector customers. Root cause is a queuing backlog during a deploy; fix rolled, queues drained.

 tom-legal: Use neutral language - "delivery lag" or "delayed webhook delivery". Offer a goodwill credit but avoid detailed fault language.

```
Subject: Update: delayed webhook delivery affecting onboarding events

Hi [Name],

We want to let you know we observed delayed webhook delivery for some connector events that may have affected onboarding flows for your account between 2026-04-02 01:15 UTC and 2026-04-02 04:40 UTC. Our engineers have applied a fix, drained the backlog, and validation is ongoing.

What were doing:
• Completed queue drain and duplicate suppression for affected events.
• Validating replayed events and confirming successful downstream processing.
• Offering a one-time goodwill credit (equivalent to 1 day of service usage) and an optional office-hours troubleshooting slot.

If youd like a replay or help confirming your onboarding state, reply and well prioritize a session. We plan to follow up with a short verification summary by EOD local time.

Thanks,
Tessa, Customer Success
```

 helen: Recommend pilot to 5 highest-risk accounts (trials + renewals). If any request > offered credit, escalate to me for renewal impact.

 diego: I can attach a small FAQ: "Will my users be duplicated?" -> "Duplicates suppressed; were reconciling records." Also include a one-click replay link for CS to trigger per-tenant.

 tom-legal: Approve with capped credit language (1 day or 5% min). Keep copy concise.

 tessa: Pilot send 11:30 PT, full send 14:00 PT pending pilot. Office hours 16:00 PT today (link: https://meet.google.com/webhook-office). Action owners: tessa  send outbound; diego  attach FAQ + replay links; rachel  share verification report; helen  handle escalations; tom-legal  final sign-off.

 cs-bot: Pilot outbound scheduled and calendar invite created for office hours (invite-id: oh-9988).

 tessa: Thanks team. Please DM me any replies needing immediate attention; Ill consolidate feedback and flag renewal risk."
